description: US Treasury reporting exchange rates — The official quarterly US Treasury exchange rates (Treasury Reporting Rates of Exchange) for about 170 currencies: foreign units per US dollar and dollars per unit, with the effective date. Required for converting foreign amounts in US government reporting, customs, grants and some tax filings. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
